verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a full REST API and specific endpoints, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path on the docs site returning 404. llms.txt is a documentation index and the MCP server is a separate capability, so neither counts as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
